input._script:
using Base64, JSON3, Random
const SRC_CPU = String(base64decode(""))
const SRC_CUDA = String(base64decode(""))
const SRC_JACC = String(base64decode(""))
include_string(Main, SRC_CPU)
include_string(Main, SRC_CUDA)
include_string(Main, SRC_JACC)
out = Any[]
for n in (1000, 40000)
    rng = MersenneTwister(7)
    x = rand(rng, n) .+ 0.5
    y0 = ones(n)
    tol = 1e-9
    yc = copy(y0); rc = zeros(1)
    f6_resid(x, yc, rc, tol, n)
    for (nm, mk, fn) in (("cuda", a -> CUDA.CuArray(a), f6_resid_cuda), ("jacc", a -> JACC.array(a), f6_resid_jacc))
        try
            xd = mk(x); yd = mk(copy(y0)); rd = mk(zeros(1))
            t = @elapsed Base.invokelatest(fn, xd, yd, rd, tol, n)
            yh = Array(yd); rh = Array(rd)
            push!(out, Dict("n" => n, "backend" => nm, "status" => (maximum(abs.(yh .- yc) ./ abs.(yc)) < 1e-12 && abs(rh[1] - rc[1]) <= 1e-9 + 1e-6 * abs(rc[1]) && yh != y0) ? "ok" : "MISMATCH",
                            "max_rel_y" => maximum(abs.(yh .- yc) ./ abs.(yc)), "res_dev" => rh[1], "res_cpu" => rc[1], "changed" => count(yh .!= y0), "seconds" => t,
                            "array_type" => string(typeof(yd))))
        catch e
            push!(out, Dict("n" => n, "backend" => nm, "status" => "exception", "msg" => first(sprint(showerror, e), 400)))
        end
    end
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("results" => out)))
